item.title: I’m 77, pay rent and live off Social Security, but I help homeless people. Why are so many people going hungry?
item.description: “I am a retired senior citizen living check-to-check.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: My friend is terminally ill. Should she sell her rental home and pay $100,000 in capital gains?
item.description: “Her younger son lives in the condo, but wants to move elsewhere with friends.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: ‘She says it’s just money’: My friend pays for everything. I should be grateful, but I can’t stand her anymore.
item.description: “On each of these weekends away, she’s probably spending $500.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: A ‘death cross’ is coming for the dollar. Why Trump will be happy.
item.description: Don’t look now, but there are some technical reasons to believe that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was right when he declared to the financial markets that “I am the house now.”
item.dc:creator: Tomi Kilgore

item.title: My husband and I are in our 50s and have no kids. We have $2 million in IRAs and 401(k)s. Do we really need a will?
item.description: “We have no debt and own our primary home, a vacation home, as well as my mother’s home in another state.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: Microsoft’s stock has roared back to life, closing at its highest level of the year
item.description: Microsoft shares got off to a rough start this year, but investors have warmed to the company’s AI narrative over the last few months.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Pedone

item.title: Apple’s expensive new iPhones could be a double-edged sword for the company
item.description: Bernstein analysts suggest Wall Street isn’t properly modeling the extent to which gross margins, a profit metric, could take a hit due to the rising costs of smartphone components.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Pedone

item.title: Micron investors should get ready for a seesaw ride, analyst says
item.description: The timing of an Nvidia product ramp may require a balancing act for Micron investors, as some estimated revenue shifts toward next year instead of this year.
item.dc:creator: Britney Nguyen

item.title: Tesla’s stock falls as launch of Semi truck fails to excite investors
item.description: Autonomous trucking represents a compelling opportunity for Tesla, but it’s unclear what the company’s initial Semi targets look like.
item.dc:creator: William Gavin

item.title: A 10% risk-free yield? For some, yes.
item.description: This could be a bargain, especially for very high earners and those in high-tax locations.
item.dc:creator: Brett Arends
